direct_blend_callback.instruction: In Creo Auxiliary Applications, register registry_file once and start it; review DLL prompts yourself. For persistence across Creo restarts, explicitly add the generated config snippet to your own loaded config.pro. The snippet is not automatically loaded. If the entry disappears after restart, fix that persistent configuration once; repeatedly selecting the dat file is temporary. An existing entry that is not running needs manual Start (delay_start true). After a payload upgrade, normally restart Creo and start the same registered application. Keep its registry_file unchanged. Legacy protocol-2 registration requires one explicit migration. A changed loader/SDK generation needs a fresh Creo startup reading the same persistent registry file; a session-only registration may need selecting that file again. MCP never changes security policy.
